title: Diagnosis Before Recovery: Turning Agent Failures into Selective Self-Correction
abstract: arXiv:2608.11772v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-correction is particularly useful when a failure constrains the next repair. Coding agents benefit from this property because compilers, tests, and execution traces turn many failures into typed recovery signals, but broad language-agent tasks often expose only a coarse task failure. This creates a tension for generic recovery playbooks: they broaden the agent's context precisely when the system needs a narrower repair interface, mixing incompatible signals for invalid actions, missing procedures, and strict-format errors. Our insight is that development-set failures can recover part of the missing diagnostic substrate by deciding which recovery interventions are admissible before test-time correction. We propose DARC, a diagnosis-guided recovery harness that profiles task-family failure modes, prunes mismatched interventions from a shared recovery library, and freezes a verifier-selected success-cost policy for deployment. translated_title: 诊断先于恢复：将智能体故障转化为选择性自我修正
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11772v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：当故障限制了下一步修复时，自我修正尤为有用。编码智能体受益于此特性，因为编译器、测试和执行轨迹能将许多故障转化为类型化的恢复信号，但广泛的语言智能体任务往往只暴露粗略的任务级故障。这给通用恢复策略手册带来了张力：它们恰恰在系统需要更窄的修复接口时拓宽了智能体的上下文，混合了无效操作、缺失程序和严格格式错误等不兼容信号。我们的见解是，开发集故障可以通过在测试时修正前决定哪些恢复干预是可接受的，来恢复部分缺失的诊断基础。我们提出了DARC，一种诊断引导的恢复框架，它分析任务族故障模式，从共享恢复库中剪除不匹配的干预措施，并冻结一个验证器选择成功成本策略以供部署。这谨慎地实现了上述机制。
tldr: 本文提出DARC框架，通过开发集故障分析来预先筛选恢复干预措施，将智能体故障转化为选择性自我修正，从而避免在测试时拓宽上下文，提升修复精准性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DARC, a diagnosis-guided recovery harness that pre-filters recovery interventions based on development-set failures, turning agent failures into selective self-correction to avoid context broadening and improve repair precision.
